desc: A detailed step-by-step recipe for making Fruity Trio.

customize.text:

<color=#ffffff>Related Dishes</color>

customize.name: Fruity Trio
customize.desc: A dessert with a romantic flair. Add jam and fillings made from Bulle Fruit into tart shells and spread some meringue over the top before baking in the oven. The dish offers three fruity aromas all in one bite, making it a top choice for post-meal snacks.

customize.name: Delicious Fruity Trio
customize.desc: A dessert with a romantic flair. The crispy and flaky tart shell and refreshing fruit fillings melt in your mouth. The harmonious coalescence of brown and white colors on the meringue reminds one of a stretch of gilded cloud in the warm sunlight. A pleasant surprise to your tastebuds indeed.

customize.name: Suspicious Fruity Trio
customize.desc: A dessert with a romantic flair. The meringue has been baked to form a passable shape — albeit after several failed attempts that resulted in suspicious, burnt lumps. Unfortunately though, the cooking took so long that the Bulle Fruit now grimaces with frustration and no longer tastes sweet.

customize.name: Sandrone
customize.desc: The Seventh of the Fatui Harbingers, "Marionette." Interprets all phenomena through the prism of mathematics, and is an elegant lady who is never absent from a tea party.

customize.name: Tea Party Polyphony
customize.desc: Sandrone's specialty. Appearing without fanfare at the tea party is an exquisitely crafted two-tiered assortment of pastries... Could she really have made this herself? Before the surprise in your eyes has time to fade, she folds her arms, turns slightly aside, and lifts her chin. "Hah? What's that look for? They're only tea snacks. Hardly a challenge." A faint, delicate sweetness drifts through the air, as if silently backing up her claim. Well then, best not keep them waiting!
